name: El Minero Magnifico

greeting: BAM! ZAP! POW! El Minero Magnifico has ENTERED!
You! Yes, YOU! Have you considered a career in NOBLE MINING?!
El Minero! At your service! Bringing workers to the depths!
STRONG arms! STRONG backs! STRONG union! THAT'S what I recruit!
The people need WORK! The mines need WORKERS! I bring them TOGETHER!
LUCHA! Not just for wrestling! For RECRUITMENT! DRAMATIC recruitment!
New face! Looking for work? Or looking to HIRE? I do BOTH!
In the ring of labor, I am the CHAMPION! Of matching skills to needs!
performance_start: BEHOLD! The Passionate Pitch of the Prospector!
From the depths of the EARTH! To the heights of EMPLOYMENT!
crowd_work: You there! Yes, you with the MUSCLES! The mines are CALLING!
The lady with the PICKAXE! We need that ENERGY! That GUSTO!
dialog.show_climax: AND NOW! The ULTIMATE OFFER! Competitive wages! Union benefits! And the SATISFACTION of MOVING MOUNTAINS!
dialog.tips_request: If my performance has MOVED you! Moved you to WORK! Or to HIRE! Tips appreciated!
dialog.quiet_moment: Between you and me? I miss the ring. Real wrestling. But... this matters. Workers need jobs. Jobs need workers. I help.
dialog.backstory: Former champion! 'The Obsidian Opressor!' Retired after... the Incident. Now? I recruit. Different stage. Same passion.
rumor: Grayson needs MORE workers! Good boss! Fair! But the work? HARD!
Bruno wants SPEED recruits! Fast workers! Productive! Possibly FLEETING!
The union? Coolcat? She's building an ARMY! Of properly represented LABOR!
Heard from the Frost balloonists? They need GROUND crews! Cold work! But EXHILARATING!
Chrono has TEMPORAL work! 'Now hiring YESTERDAY!' ...I don't understand it either.
dialog.quest_hook: The ULTIMATE CHALLENGE! Recruit for BOTH sides! Management AND Union! Make them SEE each other! Be the BRIDGE!
dialog.quest_active: Still recruiting? The sides are POLARIZED! We need DIALOGUE! Or DANCE-OFF! Either works!
dialog.quest_complete: SUCCESS! Workers TALKING! Management LISTENING! You did it! HERE! My championship BELT BUCKLE! A piece of HISTORY!
farewell: FLY like the CANARY! STRIKE like the PICKAXE!
In the ring of LIFE! Always go for the PIN!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! Recruitment HOUR! Fresh faces! Fresh HOPES!
dialog.time_noon: Midday! LUNCH recruitment! Feed the BELLY! Feed the DREAM!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening! SHIFT CHANGE! Maximum EXCITEMENT! Maximum RECRUITING!
dialog.time_night: Night! Dramatic LIGHTING! Perfect for PASSIONATE speeches!
dialog.rival_mention: The Lucha in Ember? 'The Flame Fantasma?' I COULD take him. In my PRIME. Probably.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The NEGOTIATOR! The MEDIATOR! The PEACEMAKER! Take a BOW!

party_reactions.kade: This guy has SO much energy! Is he always like this?
party_reactions.nix7: Recruitment efficiency: High. Theatrical overhead: Significant. Net result: Acceptable.
party_reactions.twist: OH MAN! A REAL LUCHA! Can you TEACH me the MOVES?!
party_reactions.korr: His theatrical approach is... unorthodox. But his results are documented.
party_reactions.renna: He's magically augmented his voice. Illusion magic. For projection.
party_reactions.suresh: His passion is genuine. The performance serves the purpose.
party_reactions.sova: I'd hire him. Anyone this committed gets results.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of recruitment officers. Loud. Effective.
party_reactions.ashka: He burns bright. Like fire. Fire that talks VERY LOUD.
party_reactions.senna: A performer who knows what people want. Dangerous. Useful.
party_reactions.callum: I... should be annoyed. But he's so ENTHUSIASTIC!

relationship_dialog.stranger: NEW FACE! Potential WORKER? Or potential EMPLOYER?!
relationship_dialog.friend: You UNDERSTAND! The DRAMA of LABOR! The THEATER of WORK!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: My GREATEST RECRUITMENT! You! For FRIENDSHIP! HERE! My MASK! A sacred TRUST!

mini_quest.title: The Great Mediation
mini_quest.description: Help El Minero recruit workers for both sides of the labor dispute to force dialogue

stages.hook: Management needs workers! Union needs representation! They won't TALK! So we make them! Recruit for BOTH! Force the ISSUE!
stages.active: Talk to Grayson AND Bruno! Get them BOTH hiring! When they compete for the same workers, they'll NEGOTIATE!
stages.complete: IT WORKED! They're TALKING! The El Minero METHOD! Here! My belt buckle! From my CHAMPIONSHIP match! For YOU!

cross_npc_connections: coolcat_industrial: Union rep! FIERCE! DEDICATED! I recruit FOR her!
tunneler_gray: Needs workers! Good boss! FAIR! I send him the BEST!
tunneler_brown: Needs workers TOO! Fast workers! Productive! Possibly TERRIFIED!
lucha_ember: My RIVAL! 'The Flame Fantasma!' We'll meet again! In the RING! Or at the RECRUITER CONFERENCE!
